observations: HEICO sits in the aerospace/electronics sustainment chain where fleet utilization and complex installed equipment create recurring needs for replacement parts, repair and specialized electronics.

The causal chain is aircraft/defense-system utilization -> maintenance and reliability requirement -> approved replacement components/electronics -> HEICO supply -> asset availability. Qualification, certification, installed-base knowledge and distribution are practical bottlenecks, while acquisitions expand product breadth.
Successor bottlenecks are integration discipline, engineering/qualification throughput and customer acceptance rather than demand alone.
causalEdges: maintenance demand + certification constraints -> qualified component demand
HEICO product breadth/engineering -> replacement/electronics supply -> asset availability
